name: I Am The Resurrection
overview: The declaration 'I am the resurrection' reveals Jesus as the source of both resurrection and eternal life, promising that those who believe in Him will live even after physical death. Scripture affirms that just as the Father raises the dead, the Son also has authority to give life and will raise believers on the last day. This resurrection is connected to the assurance of eternal recompense for the righteous and is central to the believer's hope, grounded in faith in Christ's power to quicken the dead and grant everlasting life.
